name: Morttimer
noteEs: Morttimer es uno de los creators hispanohablantes más activos del cluster ARPG, con cobertura de Path of Exile 2, Diablo 4 y Last Epoch en español. Para LE específicamente cubre cycle launches, builds starter y patch reactions. Cadencia near-diaria de streams en Twitch y uploads regulares en YouTube. Si quieres content LE en español sin tener que recurrir a traducción de creators ingleses, este es el referente.
noteEn: Morttimer is one of the most active Spanish-speaking creators in the ARPG cluster, covering Path of Exile 2, Diablo 4, and Last Epoch in Spanish. For LE specifically covers cycle launches, starter builds, and patch reactions. Near-daily Twitch streams and regular YouTube uploads. If you want LE content in Spanish without resorting to translating English creators, this is the reference.
highlightsEs: Uno de los pocos creators hispanos consistentes en el cluster ARPG
Cadencia near-diaria de streams en Twitch
Foco en starter builds y patch reactions accesibles
Útil para audiencia que prefiere content nativo en español
highlightsEn: One of the few consistent Spanish-speaking creators in the ARPG cluster
Focus on starter builds and accessible patch reactions
Useful for audience that prefers native Spanish content
